_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate favors HOLD until F&G/momentum/funding expand or break; inflows alone are not the breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/Hope; narrative flows + blowoff match imply caution without a clean phase shift
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 55-70 and 30d momentum stays ~45-60 with funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks under 55 with momentum under 45 (down to Disbelief) or F&G clears 71 with funding and momentum expanding (up to Optimism)
